title: ISic000692. Epitaph for Onomaste
body:
Text encoding: Alex Antoniou, Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Autopsy by Alex Antoniou, 2022-07-14, Antiquarium room 5, case 6, second shelf.
1Onomaste
2vix(it) · ann(is)
3XV

Text encoding: Alex Antoniou, Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Autopsy by Alex Antoniou, 2022-07-14, Antiquarium room 5, case 6, second shelf.
1ONOMASTE
2VIX·ANN
3XV

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text based on autopsy

English translation

Alex Antoniou

Onomaste lived for 15 years.

commentary

The name Onomaste/us is well attested in Rome and Campania.

bibliography

  • 1989.0338l https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10001283
  • Manganaro 1989 165 no.20 fig.20 https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10001831
  • Fasolo 2013 84 no.31 fig.57 https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10002011

Thick v-cut letters, of fairly regular and moderately narrow module, with deep wedge serifs. E shows slight curvature to the bars, A with a sloping cross-bar.

Line 1 32-38 Line 2 31-33 Line 3 31 Interlineation line 1 to 2
